lines.text: A budget usually dies of upkeep, not willpower: the numbers drift, you stop trusting them, you stop opening it.
Five tests for one that lasts.

eyebrow.text: The upkeep small enough to keep

head.text: Pick one weekday and put it in your calendar today.

body.text: A fixed day means it happens without a decision.

eyebrow.text: Five tests before you spend a weekend on setup

items.text: It answers one question you actually ask, such as what's safe to spend this month.
After two skipped weeks, its main number would still be roughly right.
It tells you when its number is old or built on missing information.
You can restart from today's balance in minutes, without back-filling.

line.text: Because they need daily upkeep. This one has a short weekly check-in and a quiet way back in when you have been away for weeks.
